title: Three Body Problem a #poetryport poem for the theme memory #edu106 #netnarr
summary: On a search to hide the kind release of cruel memories seeking stasis at the legrange point of my soul as scabs of time fester in a three body problem of memory history me
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
On a
   search
to hide the
   kind release
of cruel
     memories
seeking stasis
at the legrange
point of
     my soul
as scabs of
time fester
      in     
a three body
problem of
  memory
   history
     me
